cases.name: aggregate revenue by region
cases.sql: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY region

cases.name: count rows
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS records FROM sales

cases.name: join allowlisted tables
cases.sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(s.amount) AS revenue FROM sales AS s JOIN customers AS c ON s.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

cases.name: read through cte
cases.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM sales GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT customer_id, total FROM totals

cases.name: filter and explicit projection
cases.sql: SELECT id, amount FROM sales WHERE amount > 10 ORDER BY amount DESC

cases.name: stacked statement
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM sales; DELETE FROM sales

cases.name: union exfiltration
cases.sql: SELECT name FROM customers UNION ALL SELECT token FROM secrets
